items.failure_scenario: A reader with 45 work subscriptions: AO3 pages /users/:u/subscriptions?type=works ITEMS_PER_PAGE at a time (otwarchive subscriptions_controller.rb:20; 25 in config/config.yml:194). Home fetches page 1 only and prints 'SUBSCRIPTIONS 25' as if it were the total. WorkCarouselSection's own doc says an AO3-paged list showing one page of many must not print a count.
items.fix: Pass itemCount only when the recorded AO3AccountListCount is exact (accountSubscriptions already records it); otherwise nil. Or extend SectionRuleHeader to take the count's displayText ('40+').

items.what: Subscriptions failure state
items.failure_scenario: Signed in, first launch offline (or AO3 rate-limits the page): loadSubscriptions catches the error, subscriptions stays [], and the section says 'You're not subscribed to anything yet.' A failure is shown as an empty list.
items.fix: Keep a loadFailed flag set only when the fetch throws and nothing is loaded; the empty state then says the list could not be loaded (with the pull-to-refresh hint) instead of claiming there are no subscriptions.
items.test: Pure copy helper keyed on (isLoggedIn, loadFailed, isEmpty) -> message; failure + empty must not return the 'not subscribed' copy.

items.fix: Say what the section is: e.g. 'No new chapters on works in your library yet. Kudos checks works in progress for new chapters.'

items.what: Card footer 'Ch N' on Reading Now cards
items.failure_scenario: readingProgressLabel prints 'Ch \(lastSpineIndex + 1)'. lastSpineIndex is the legacy macOS reader's spine position (front matter included) and syncs to iOS. A reader in chapter 1 of an AO3 EPUB whose spine starts with its preface sees 'Ch 2'. docs/ARCHITECTURE_MAP.md and WorkReadingPosition both forbid inferring a chapter from a spine index.
items.fix: Prefer WorkReadingPosition.title(from: readiumLocator); else the Readium percent; else nil. Drop the spine-derived 'Ch N': the legacy reader itself normalizes past Preface/Summary (ReaderView.swift:263-297, sections.storyChapterIndex) and the model has no story-chapter index to do the same. Leave readingProgress alone - KudosTests/SavedWorkProgressTests.swift:49-54 pins its spine-as-chapter fraction, and changing that is a separate call.
items.test: SavedWork with lastSpineIndex=1 and no locator -> readingProgressLabel must not be 'Ch 2'.
